welcome.title: Welcome to {appName} 👋
welcome.description: Let's take a quick tour of your management space. You'll discover what each section is for and how to get started. You can restart this tour anytime with the help button in the top right.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Your starting point: key figures, upcoming events, and your association's recent activity at a glance.

membres.title: Members
membres.description: The heart of your association. Add a member with the "Add" button at the top of the page, import a list, filter by status or type, and send bulk SMS.

evenements.title: Events
evenements.description: Create an event (meeting, outing, workshop…) with "New event". Manage RSVPs, the location on the map, and sell paid tickets via Stripe.

cotisations.title: Membership fees
cotisations.description: Track each member's annual membership fee: who has paid, who still needs a reminder. Set the amount and export tracking whenever you like.

tresorerie.title: Treasury
tresorerie.description: Record income and expenses by category to track your association's balance. Add a transaction with the dedicated button at the top of the page.

dons.title: Donations
dons.description: Collect and track donations made to your association, with details per donor.

reunions.title: Meetings
reunions.description: Hold video meetings directly in {appName}. Create a meeting and share the link with participants.

sondages.title: Polls
sondages.description: Consult your members: create a poll, add your questions, and track responses in real time.

boutique.title: Shop
boutique.description: Sell products or merchandise to your members. Add an item, set its price, and manage orders.

actualites.title: News
actualites.description: Publish articles with rich text and images. Choose the recipients: a real-time notification alerts them automatically.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Chat with your members from a centralized messaging space.

materiel.title: Equipment
materiel.description: Keep an inventory of your association's equipment and track loans and borrowings.

site.title: Website
site.description: Customize your association's public page: banner, events, news, membership form, and contact. Every section is modular.

activite.title: History
activite.description: Find the log of actions taken in the management space to keep track of what's changed.

parametres.title: Settings
parametres.description: Configure your association and enable or disable each module. A disabled module disappears from the menu, but your data is kept.

viewSwitcher.title: Switch space
viewSwitcher.description: Switch from the management space to "My space", the member view of the portal, to see what your members see.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Your real-time alerts appear here: new registrations, responses, payments…

themeToggle.title: Light / dark theme
themeToggle.description: Switch between light and dark mode based on your preference.

userMenu.description: Edit your profile, change your password, and sign out from this menu.
